evidence_boundary.deterministic_conformance: required regression gate; never provider-live evidence
evidence_boundary.provider_live: one fresh, synthetic-resource receipt and readback for the named tracker and host
evidence_boundary.unknown: blocks PASS; it must not be projected as success

budget.quota: record only when the host or provider exposes it

host_preconditions: the installed Foundry distribution files match the exact SHA recorded in the external live evidence before a cell starts
the host selects the synthetic repository binding and its active tracker credentials
the effective pre-push hook chain enforces both the local privacy guard and plugins/foundry/.githooks/pre-push for the synthetic checkout
a separate Ship-iOS test application and TestFlight-only authorization are available for the shared Apple path
pass_condition: all six cells have fresh provider_live receipts, all required_journey entries are evidenced, adversarial cases fail closed, and required human validation is recorded
forbidden_inference: a PAT-68 fake-transport pass makes a real cell pass
a reusable provider proof makes the other host pass
an archived binding may be reactivated as a recipe shortcut
a Ship-iOS mock proves an Apple provider action
